sections.subheading: Am I My Brother's Keeper? | Matthew 25:35-40

children.text: Welcome to the home page of the Sigma Delta Sigma chapter of Phi Beta Sigma Fraternity Inc. Woodstock, GA is our base of operation, but we are dedicated to providing services in the name of Sigma where we are needed. We invite you to check out our website to learn more about our chapter and Phi Beta Sigma.

cards.title: Bigger & Better Business
cards.text: Supporting Black-owned businesses and entrepreneurship in our community.

cards.title: Education
cards.text: Scholarships and mentorship for the next generation.

cards.title: Social Action
cards.text: Civic engagement, health, and service where we are needed.

sections.heading: Questions about the chapter?
sections.text: We'd love to hear from you.

children.text: Phi Beta Sigma Fraternity, Inc. was founded on January 9, 1914, at Howard University in Washington, D.C.
Our motto: Culture For Service and Service For Humanity.
